newsitem.title: HONG KONG: The greatest Chinese takeaway in the world.
newsitem.headline: The greatest Chinese takeaway in the world.

text.p: It may be the greatest takeover of all time.

Brokers joke about the ultimate "Chinese takeaway", but if Hong Kong Limited were a company targeted for takeover by Greater China Inc, it might be worth more than $5 trillion -- three times the annual U.S. budget of $1.7 trillion.
Half of this sum is property, the rest is GDP (gross domestic product), the value of goods and services, based on current share multiples of about 17.
Other factors -- people, computers, goodwill -- would push the price up even further.
The reunification could also be seen as a thrilling but risky marriage.

Attractive, rich career woman, lavish urban lifestyle, meets plain-living, revolutionary, hunky suitor of peasant origins, with past predeliction for violence against relatives, but currently reforming and dedicated to hard work.

To ease life together, the couple agreed to separate quarters in the same house until they get used to each other -- a 50-year interval as condition of Hong Kong becoming an autonomous region of China.

Abducted from China in the 19th century, the bride dallied uneasily with colonial suitor Britain until the latter's lease ran out and destiny called. She had meanwhile grown fabulously wealthy and accustomed to massive economic freedom.
Marriage counsellors are reserved about the chances of such a union.
"Normally a lot of willingness to compromise would be advised," says a Hong Kong marriage guidance expert.
